_doc: Registry of the cloud project. clone.sh reads this and nothing else. A SUBSET of repo_master/repos.json, which indexes every repository this account owns — the entries here must match it field for field. Deliberately NOT submodules: a submodule pins a commit, and this is an index of working clones, not a pinned build input.
base_dir_doc: Where clones live. Override with $CLOUD_GIT_BASE; otherwise ~/git. Clones are NEVER placed inside this repo — cloud-master holds relative symlinks pointing out to them, committed, so `ls` is the project and a dangling link is just a repo you have not cloned yet. An entry with no `group` links at the repo ROOT (../<name>); 2_vault is a config tier, not a repo group, and its one entry links at 2_vault/vault (../../vault).
_visibility_doc: `private` mirrors GitHub visibility as of 2026-08-11 and only drives the "(private)" hint in `--list` plus a clearer message when a clone fails for lack of credentials. It grants nothing.

groups.2_vault: Secrets (sops/age) — every credential the fleet uses. Numbered so it sorts ahead of the lettered groups: it is the one repo whose absence breaks the others.

repos.name: cloud-vault
repos.doc: Secrets (sops/age). Every credential the fleet uses.

repos.name: cloud-infra
repos.doc: Fleet: services, infra, the derive engine (1_cloud-configs).

repos.name: cloud-data
repos.doc: Generated fleet config consumed by cloud's services.

repos.name: front
repos.doc: Front-end: the published site and its derive job (1_front-configs). Cloned as 'front', not after its repo name — 112 files across unix and cloud reference ~/git/front, and it matches its siblings front-data/front-assets-cdn.

repos.name: front-unity
repos.doc: Unity asset pipeline (unity-asset-vm: upkg2gltf, fetch-and-convert) plus its assets. Was front-asset-cdn, the predecessor of front-assets-cdn; renamed 2026-08-18 to match what it actually holds - the CDN itself is front-assets-cdn.

repos.name: front-assets-cdn
repos.doc: Front-end static assets served from the CDN.

repos.name: cloud-unix
repos.doc: Workstation + device configuration, nix flakes, the superapp. Holds the Claude SoT (da_my-ai/src/data/claude).

repos.name: cloud-data-my-ai_memory
repos.doc: Claude Codes durable state and the source it runs from. ~/.claude symlinks in, not out: a_sessions/<instance>/ holds transcripts, file-history, shell-snapshots and history.jsonl; b_projects/ holds MEMORY.md and memory-entries; a_commits/ snapshots every commit object of every repo here.

_root_doc: The twelve cloud repos have no `group` and sit at the root of this repo. They are the whole of it, so wrapping them in an a_cloud/ directory added a level that distinguished nothing.
